metadata.description: Typecast TTS API integration skills and tools for Claude Code. Covers API integration and rights-cleared short-form video creation with Typecast narration and captions.

plugins.name: typecast-api-expert
plugins.description: Typecast TTS API expert agent. Covers API key setup, code samples, troubleshooting, plan comparison, and the newer surface area: streaming TTS, timestamp-aligned captions (SRT/VTT), runtime subscription lookup, target_lufs loudness normalization, Quick Voice Cloning, and the cast CLI. Use for 'Typecast API', 'TTS integration', 'streaming TTS', 'voice cloning', 'TTS captions', 'cast CLI', or 'text-to-speech API' questions.

plugins.name: create-typecast-shorts
plugins.description: Create a captioned 9:16 short or reel from one rights-cleared local video or image using Typecast narration, cast captions, and ffmpeg.
